description: This file defines the 'SiloEntity' class, a model representing a silo in a clustering system for Orleans with Cosmos DB integration. It includes properties like Address, Port, Status, and various timestamps, and is used for serialization/deserialization of silo data in the context of Cosmos DB.

classes.name: SiloEntity
classes.description: A model class representing a silo in an Orleans clustering system, including various properties for silo identification and status.

methods.name: EntityType
methods.description: Override property returning the name of the entity type, 'SiloEntity'.
